title: Furniture labels to cut out
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: My new home; my room and furniture; describing my appearance and clothes
source: Written for arabic/y5 lesson 6 (Furniture labels to cut out (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 6: My room and its furniture. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: There is
points: In my room there is a bed

blocks.task: stick each label on the furniture at home, and say هٰذَا ... or هٰذِهِ ....

questions.q: Say: In my room there is a big wardrobe.
Boy word or girl word: نَافِذَة?
Core: Write four sentences about your room: فِي غُرْفَتِي ...
questions.a: For example: فِي غُرْفَتِي سَرِيرٌ. فِي غُرْفَتِي كُرْسِيٌّ. فِي غُرْفَتِي نَافِذَةٌ. فِي غُرْفَتِي مَكْتَبٌ.

questions.q: Extend: Add an adjective to two of your sentences, with ة for girl words.
questions.a: For example: فِي غُرْفَتِي سَرِيرٌ كَبِيرٌ وَطَاوِلَةٌ صَغِيرَةٌ.

questions.q: Stretch: Write the plural: chair, كُرْسِيّ → كَرَاسِيّ, and use it: فِي غُرْفَتِي كَرَاسِيُّ.
questions.a: فِي غُرْفَتِي كَرَاسِيُّ (there are chairs in my room)

questions.q: Which is correct for 'a small table'?
questions.a: B) طَاوِلَةٌ صَغِيرَةٌ. طَاوِلَة is a girl word, so the adjective also takes ة, and it comes after the noun.

questions.q: What is سَرِير? A) bed B) chair C) window
Big question: describe your room in one Arabic sentence with an adjective.
questions.a: For example: فِي غُرْفَتِي سَرِيرٌ كَبِيرٌ.
